conclusion: The devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern specification has been successfully enforced with significant improvements in configuration compliance, log visibility, and deployment standardization. While the core enforcement is complete (Helm upgrade applied, configuration aligned), an outstanding ACP server startup issue prevents full validation success. The specification has been committed (bae2e8a) and tagged (spec-devbob-k8s-deployment-pattern-v1) with comprehensive documentation and validation harness for future reference.
